claims.text: Iran hits all Gulf oil fields and US bases; blocks Bab el-Mandeb
claims.source: Saudi Ras Tanura & Al-Udeid struck; all 6 GCC nations hit. Bab el-Mandeb: Houthi ceasefire in effect — ACLED / NBC News

updates.text: Reports confirm Iranian-backed Houthi attacks in the Red Sea and strikes on Gulf oil fields. US base attacks and full Bab el-Mandeb blockage remain unconfirmed.

Reports confirm Houthi (Iran-backed) involvement in the conflict and threats to global shipping via the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, but no direct attacks on Gulf oil fields or US bases are explicitly stated.

claims.text: US tries amphibious invasion of Iran — first attempt fails with massive casualties
claims.source: Conflict has been air/naval only — CENTCOM Operation Epic Fury. No ground invasion yet.

updates.text: Troop deployments and naval assets are moving into the Middle East, increasing tensions with Iran. However, no headlines confirm an amphibious invasion or resulting casualties.
Increased US military presence and deployments of Marines to the Middle East suggest heightened tensions and potential for escalation, but no amphibious invasion has been confirmed.

claims.text: Second attempt succeeds, oil fields seized, advance halts
claims.source: No such event — first invasion attempt has not even occurred yet
keywords: US Iran ground operation oil field

updates.text: Headlines discuss planning and consideration of seizing Iranian oil fields, specifically Kharg Island, but do not confirm successful seizure. Advance halting is not mentioned either.
Headlines indicate US forces have seized Kharg Island, but also mention the advance has halted. The claim of 'second attempt succeeds' is not explicitly confirmed, only the first part of the claim.
Headlines indicate planning and consideration of seizing Kharg Island and ground operations in Iran, but no headline confirms successful seizure of oil fields or a halt to the advance.

claims.text: US civil war; anti-war bloc seizes DC with military support
claims.source: No evidence of any such event

claims.text: US splits in two and retreats from Middle East
claims.source: US expanding operations, not retreating — CENTCOM (March 2026)

updates.text: While troop withdrawals from Germany are occurring and Iran indicates a need for US engagement, no headlines confirm a full US split or complete Middle East retreat.

While the US maintains a presence and is engaged in conflict with Iran, headlines suggest a reduced, reactive role, hinting at a strategic shift away from the Middle East, but not a complete split or retreat.
Troop withdrawals from Germany and ongoing conflict with Iran suggest a reduced US presence and shifting foreign policy, but a 'split' isn't confirmed.

claims.text: Turkey betrays NATO, joins Russia-Iran-China, attacks Israel
claims.source: Turkey condemned strikes; closed airspace to US ops. NATO intact. Has not attacked Israel.

updates.text: Headlines indicate Turkey intercepted Iranian missiles and issued warnings, suggesting a shift in regional alignment, but not definitive betrayal of NATO or full alliance with Russia/China or attacks on Israel.
Headlines confirm Turkey intercepted Iranian missiles and tensions exist. No definitive evidence supports joining Russia-Iran-China or attacking Israel, but regional realignment is noted.

Headlines confirm Turkey intercepted Iranian missiles and is navigating increased regional instability, suggesting a shift in relations. No explicit alliance with Russia/China or attack on Israel is confirmed.

claims.text: China invades Taiwan and Guam
claims.source: No invasion. China opposes war rhetorically, has not aided Iran materially.

updates.text: China raised defense budget 7%, escalated Taiwan rhetoric, improving amphibious capabilities. US arms deal to Taiwan suspended. ISW/AEI warn Iran war created Taiwan vulnerability window. Xi-Trump summit scheduled end of March.
Recent headlines indicate heightened tensions and military activity around Taiwan and airspace near Japan/South Korea, but no confirmed invasion of Taiwan or Guam has occurred.
Headlines indicate heightened military activity between China and Taiwan, but no explicit confirmation of a full-scale invasion. The situation remains tense and requires continued monitoring.

claims.text: North Korea invades South Korea; Japan fails to stop it
claims.source: No invasion. NK condemned US-Israeli strikes, no direct military involvement.

updates.text: Recent headlines report North Korea firing ballistic missiles, demonstrating increased military activity and tensions on the Korean Peninsula. No invasion has been confirmed.
Recent headlines detail North Korean missile launches and border provocations, indicating heightened tensions but no confirmed invasion of South Korea.
Recent headlines report North Korea firing ballistic missiles, escalating tensions. However, there is no confirmation of a full-scale invasion of South Korea.

claims.text: India possibly flips sides
claims.source: India received Iranian Hormuz transit permission. Pragmatic neutrality — Al Jazeera (March 2026)

updates.text: Headlines explicitly state India has chosen to back Israel over Iran, indicating a shift in alignment. This contradicts the original claim of 'possibly flipping sides' and confirms a change in stance.
